## Tabs with code

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Python

```{.python code-line-numbers="2-3"}
def lorem(n: int) -> list[str]:
    words = ["lorem", "ipsum", "dolor"]
    return [words[i % len(words)] for i in range(n)]
```

### Bash

```bash
for word in lorem ipsum dolor; do
  printf '%s\n' "$word"
done
```

### R

```r
words <- c("lorem", "ipsum", "dolor")
paste(rep(words, length.out = 5), collapse = " ")
```
